searched.title: Bambu Lab US store product page: Tungsten Carbide Hotend - H2/P2S/X2D
searched.note: The P0 corpus copy, parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload with the manifest row). Product Specifications: Max. Printing Temp. 350 ℃, Length 49.2 mm, Packaging Weight 0.026 kg, Packaging Size 60*60*30 mm (all kept by the deterministic layer; this file repeats them as reviewed evidence at the same values and rank, the Size values' diameter and material too, and takes the 350 ℃ from the wiki, which agrees). In the Box: "Tungsten Carbide Nozzle *1". No width, height, net weight, filament diameter or electrical value. Its "HRA 90" hardness (features, overview) has no registry key for a hotend (mechanical.hardness is a filament key), and "50% increase in lifespan", "up to 62.5% higher max volumetric speed" and "up to 30%" time saving are marketing prose: not stored. "Not recommended" cells get no relation: PLA Silk+ at Standard Flow 0.6 mm; PLA Silk+ at Standard Flow 0.8 mm; PLA Silk Dual Color at Standard Flow 0.6 mm; PLA Silk Dual Color at Standard Flow 0.8 mm; PLA Silk at Standard Flow 0.6 mm; PLA Silk at Standard Flow 0.8 mm; PLA-CF at High Flow 0.4 mm; PLA Aero at Standard Flow 0.6 mm; PLA Aero at Standard Flow 0.8 mm; PETG-CF at High Flow 0.4 mm; ASA Aero at Standard Flow 0.6 mm; ASA Aero at Standard Flow 0.8 mm; ASA-CF at High Flow 0.4 mm; TPU 85A at Standard Flow 0.6 mm; TPU 85A at Standard Flow 0.8 mm; TPU 90A at Standard Flow 0.4 mm; TPU 90A at Standard Flow 0.6 mm; TPU 90A at Standard Flow 0.8 mm; PAHT-CF at High Flow 0.4 mm; PA6-CF at High Flow 0.4 mm; PA6-GF at High Flow 0.4 mm.

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "Tungsten Carbide Nozzle" panel (purchase links "Tungsten Carbide Nozzle - Standard & High Flow") and the Nozzle-Printer Compatibility rows "Tungsten Carbide Nozzle" and "High Flow Tungsten Carbide Nozzle" name this product. Its "Size: 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm" agrees with the page's Size values (diameter and material stay with those option values, official_variant). It states no dimensions, weight, flow rate or electrical value for this product; its "significantly less wear" sentence and the feature bullets ("HRA 90 Tougher nozzle", "Save Up to 30% of Your Time") prove no number.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Linked from the store page. A general guide for every Bambu nozzle (columns 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm Nozzle and 0.4/0.6/0.8 mm High flow nozzle), not for the Tungsten Carbide nozzle, so none of its rows is stored as a spec of this product; it is used only to flag disagreements with the page's two Filament Compatibility tables (conflict notes on TPU 85A, TPU 90A, PET-CF, PPA-CF and PPS-CF). Where the page is stricter than the wiki and says "Not recommended" (PLA Silk+/Silk Dual Color/Silk/PLA Aero/ASA Aero at Standard Flow 0.6/0.8 mm; TPU 85A and TPU 90A at Standard Flow), no relation is recorded. Its 0.4 mm hardened steel advice (layer height 0.15–0.3 mm, about 100 mm/s) is for fibre-filled filaments on hardened steel only; not stored.
